title: Last Bell, 2011
logline: Two weeks after being let go. The bell. Wood is on the beach at 3:05 with the lamp — he's carried it down to draw by. The strip finds that funny and then doesn't.

panels.composition: The beach, 3:05 PM. WOOD on the drift log. Beside him on the sand: the green swing-arm lamp, unplugged, carried down. BARNABY. The bell, faint, from town.

image.prompt: a thin man on a bleached drift log on a beach with a green enameled swing-arm lamp set unplugged on the sand beside him, an old dog, a faint bell sound from a distant town, muddy flats

panels.composition: The lamp on the sand. The cord trailing to nothing.

image.prompt: close-up of a green swing-arm lamp standing on beach sand with its cord trailing away to nothing

balloons.text: I know. I know there's no outlet. It's the principle. It's my lamp and I'm drawing by it.

image.prompt: a man on a beach log explaining to a dog why he brought a lamp, rueful

panels.composition: Wood drawing. The lamp beside him, off, in daylight. The dog. The tide. It works fine.

image.prompt: a man drawing on a beach log beside an unlit lamp in full daylight, an old dog, the tide coming in, no words

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; Sundays the point

notes: The lamp on the beach. It works fine.
